question.text: How do changes in radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

exchange.sent: How do changes in radar technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

answer.answer:
The passages do not directly state how radar-technology changes affect requirements for a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester, but they support the following technical implication: newer radar-related needs move beyond ordinary communication signaling/protocol tests toward RF/non-signaling and radar-echo capabilities such as higher frequency coverage, wider bandwidth, dynamic artificial objects, distance/RCS/Doppler control, and multi-object or frontend configurations [4][8][57][58][59][60][61].
| Radar technology change / need | Measurement capability affected | Supported evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Higher radar RF bands, especially automotive radar at 76 GHz to 81 GHz, require tester capability beyond a CMX500-style communication RF range of 400 MHz to 8 GHz [49][61]. | Non-signaling / radar test capability needs mmWave radar frontend or echo-generation coverage rather than only sub-8 GHz communication signaling [49][61]. | CMX500 RF range is 400 MHz to 8 GHz for LTE, 5G and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test [49]; AREG800A radar frontends cover 76 GHz to 81 GHz and 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz, with FE44S at 24 GHz to 44 GHz [61]. |
| Wider radar instantaneous bandwidth increases required IF/baseband bandwidth capability [61]. | A radar-capable non-signaling tester or echo generator needs IF bandwidth options at 1 GHz, 2 GHz or 5 GHz, not only communication-channel RF measurements [61]. | AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth is 1 GHz, 2 GHz or 5 GHz depending on option, with overrange of 1.2 GHz, 2.2 GHz or 5.2 GHz [61]. |
| FMCW radar and near-object testing require artificial-object generation tied to air gap and short-distance behavior [8][58]. | The tester must generate radar echoes with minimum artificial-object distance from air gap or short ranges such as <17 m + air gap, <4 m + air gap, or ≥ air gap, depending on option [8][58]. | AREG800A digital echo generation is used for FMCW radar, with minimum generated distance equal to the radar under test’s air gap value and maximum generated distance 3000 m [8]; artificial-object distance options include <17 m + air gap, <4 m + air gap, and ≥ air gap [58]. |
| Longer-range and dynamic object scenarios require dynamic artificial-object generation over large distance ranges [8][58]. | The tester needs dynamic echo generation with covered artificial-object distance up to 3000 m, or 350 m in specified production frontend configurations [8][58]. | AREG800A echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation [8]; covered artificial-object distance can be <17 m to 3000 m, <4 m to 3000 m, ≥ air gap to 3000 m, or in production frontend configurations FMCW ≥ air gap to 350 m and non-FMCW <17 m to 350 m [58]. |
| Radar target-strength variation requires RCS control and dynamic range [57]. | The tester needs dynamic RCS range and fine RCS step size capability [57]. | AREG800A dynamic RCS range is 90 dB for all artificial objects on one IF path with listed AREG8 frontends, >60 dB with QAT100, 60 dB for multiple objects per IF path with listed AREG8 frontends, and RCS control step size is 0.1 dB [57]. |
| Moving-target simulation requires Doppler and radial-velocity capability [59]. | The tester needs individual Doppler frequency shift, velocity range, velocity step size, Doppler accuracy and velocity accuracy capability [59]. | AREG800A supports individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, velocity setting range ±500 km/h with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, velocity step size 0.001 km/h for AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, Doppler frequency offset accuracy <1 Hz, and velocity accuracy <0.05 km/h [59]. |
| Multi-channel or production radar configurations require multiple digital channels and frontend configurations [60]. | The tester configuration may need one, two, or three digital channels and monostatic or bistatic frontend support depending on radar production configuration [60]. | AREG-P1 / AREG-DBP1 provides one digital channel and one object per channel, AREG-P2 / AREG-DBP2 provides two digital channels, and AREG-P3 / AREG-DBP3 provides three digital channels with AREG-MFP / AREG-BFP frontend option supporting monostatic or bistatic operation [60]. |
| Communication signaling testers remain oriented to LTE, NR and WLAN signaling, protocol/application/RF communication measurements rather than radar echo generation [1][4]. | Signaling tester capability is still relevant for communication links and de-sense validation, but the cited CMX500 signaling functions do not state automotive radar echo generation capability [1][4]. | Signaling test can include basic RF measurements, application-layer tests and protocol test, with basic RF measurements including Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER and MIMO [1]; CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN signaling and TX measurements, BLER, throughput and PER measurement [4]. |
| For UAV or multi-radio products, multiple communication technologies can create mutual interference, so signaling testing may need multi-technology de-sense validation rather than radar measurement [1]. | The communication tester requirement is multi-technology support and combined configuration for de-sense validation, not radar echo simulation in the cited passage [1]. | The source says if a UAV uses two or more communication technologies, those technologies may interfere with each other, and because CMX500 supports multiple communication technologies, it can be used for de-sense validation [1]. |
| Non-signaling is only identified in the raw passages as RF, while signaling is identified as protocol / pre-conformance [99]. | The passages support only a high-level distinction that radar-like RF measurement demands would align more with non-signaling RF capability than with signaling protocol capability [99]. | RAW states “Non-signaling - RF” and “Signaling - Protocol Pre-conformance” [99]. |
【推論】As radar technology moves toward mmWave bands, wider bandwidth, FMCW near-object behavior, dynamic objects, RCS and Doppler, the required tester capability shifts from only communication signaling/protocol measurements toward non-signaling RF plus dedicated radar echo-generation capability such as AREG800A-class functions [49][61][8][57][58][59][99].

- 來源指出無人機常使用多種通信技術，例子包含 proprietary radio / image transmission、Wi‑Fi、[[LTE]]、未來 [[5G]]、[[RTK]]、[[SATCOM]] 與 encrypted frequency-hopping radio。
- 來源以多款無人機 / UAV 產品為例整理核心通訊技術：[[DJI Mini 4 Pro]]、[[DJI Mavic 3]]、[[DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise]]、[[Parrot ANAFI Ai]]、[[XAG P100]]、[[Skydio X2E]]、[[RQ-4 Global Hawk]] 與 [[Switchblade]]。

- 來源列出一組 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi test configuration，包含 WLAN signaling、WLAN TX measurement 與 WLAN ARB generator options，例如 [[R&S CMX-KS350B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS351B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS352B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS355B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS356B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS360B]]、[[R&S CMX-KM350]]、[[R&S CMX-KM351]]、[[R&S CMX-KM352]]、[[R&S CMX-KM360]]、[[R&S CMX-KW350]]、[[R&S CMX-KW351]]、[[R&S CMX-KW352]]。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S AREG800A › 文件與適用條件
- 來源文件：[[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]]。
- 文件編號：`PD 3609.8015.22`。
- 文件版本：`Version 09.00`。
- 文件日期：`September 2025（LA）`。
- 文件名稱：`AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`。
- Copyright：`© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。
- 資料註記：無 tolerance limits 的資料不具 binding 效力；資料 `subject to change`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 於環境溫度儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- `Specifications with limits`：以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示保證產品性能。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：表示保證產品性能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依 GUM 計算。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

R&S AREG800A › R&S AREG8-81S / R&S AREG8-81D
RF transfer characteristics 量測條件：with diplexer between RX and TX，frequency step size `2.5 MHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 kHz`，window function normal gate（Hann），type bandpass filter，measured from RX waveguide input to waveguide TX output connector。

- Amplitude flatness：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] `< ±1 dB in 1 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±2 dB in 2 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±5 dB in 4 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`。
- Group delay flatness：[[R&S AREG8-B9]] `< ±0.5 ns in 1 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±1 ns in 2 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`；[[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option `< ±1 ns in 4 GHz bandwidth (meas.)`。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S AREG800A]] Automotive Radar Echo Generator 的 specifications，文件編號 `PD 3609.8015.22`，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`，文件標題為 `AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`，Copyright `© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。

[[R&S AREG800A]] 的 echo generator type 為 `dynamic artificial object generation`。Echo generation concept 分為：

- `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
- `digital`：針對 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 `air gap value`；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 在環境溫度下儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格資料定義：

- `Specifications with limits`：代表保證的產品效能，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：代表保證的產品效能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依據 GUM 計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Data without tolerance limits is not binding`；文件 `subject to change`。

主要能力與限制：

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S AREG-MFP]]、[[R&S AREG-BFP]] — production frontend options，支援 monostatic 或 bistatic。
- [[Automotive radar echo generation]]、[[FMCW radar]]、[[Radar cross-section]]、[[Doppler frequency shift]]、[[Hardware-in-the-loop]]、[[Open Simulation Interface]]、[[SCPI]]、[[Air gap]] — 本來源涉及的技術概念。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 與既有知識的關係
本來源已對應既有來源頁 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] 與實體頁 [[R&S AREG800A]]。本次 ingest 依同一 raw source 重新校對既有頁面，補入或修正：

- [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81D]] 的 AUX IF output、RX power output、AUX IF input 與 connector 資訊。
- [[R&S QAT100]] 搭配 [[R&S AREG800A]] 的 IF level 與 amplitude flatness 摘要。
- 讀圖補充 p001、p021、p022、p023 的低可信度註記。
- `0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz` 條件、RF transfer characteristics 中未完整保留 option code 的 unresolved 記錄。

本來源與其他 Rohde & Schwarz Productions 頁面（如 [[R&S SGU100A]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]）同屬 test & measurement 產品資料，但用途為 automotive radar echo generation，不屬 RF signal generator 或 spectrum analyzer。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › RF path combination 與 chassis
- RF path combination table：`●` 代表 possible；`–` 代表 not possible；灰底格代表該 RF path combination 需要 `R&S®SMW-B94L` deeper chassis；白底格使用 standard chassis。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L`：Deeper chassis，Order No. `1438.8150.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L` required and only possible for RF path combinations：`2 × 12.75 GHz`、`2 × 31.8 GHz`、`2 × 44 GHz`。
- 44 GHz 組合限制：`R&S®SMW-B1044` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044N` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044N` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044O` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044O` 組合。

R&S SMW200A › Remote control、connectors 與一般資料
- Remote control interfaces：IEC 60625 GPIB IEEE-488.2、Ethernet/LAN 10/100/1000BASE-T、USB 3.0 super speed、serial RS-232 via `R&S®TS-USB1`。

Beamforming › MWC 2025 mobile network infrastructure 簡報
依 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]]（MWC 2025 Barcelona；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- [[Beamforming]] 被定義為：increases antenna gain by bundling transmitted energy and directing it towards the user。
- [[MIMO]] 被定義為：many antennas at the transceiver to increase capacity。
- [[Massive MIMO]] 被定義為：very high number of antenna elements at the transceiver，並且是 beamforming and spatial multiplexing 的 combination。
- 來源說 increasing demand for higher MIMO degree，且有 mid-band spectrum 的 operators 對 Massive MIMO 更有信心，例子包括 China、US。
- 來源說 [[Beamforming]] 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- 測試方案包含 up to nx8 MIMO generation & analysis、5G NR multi-channel analysis、signal generation with integrated fading simulation、[[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- 來源另列 beamforming components & accuracy verification：fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument、verify beamformer ICs for phased array antennas、2D/3D beamforming / beam-steering verification。
- 對應產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution，18 GHz–90 GHz）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。

6G NTN 展望
[[6G NTN 展望]] 是 [[5G-NTN-takes-flight-A-deep-dive_wp_en_3673-3210-52_v0100]] 對 [[5G NTN]] 演進到 IMT-2030 / [[6G]] unified 3D network 的技術展望，涵蓋 multi-band、multi-layer、multi-dimension architecture、MFSS、PNT、ISAC、AI、security、routing 與 3GPP timeline。

6G NTN 展望 › ISAC
[[ISAC]] 將 sensing capability 整合進 communications network。

- satellite sensing 可為 active / passive、imaging / non-imaging、monostatic / bistatic / multistatic。
- ISAC 可能支援 drones、transportation、refrigerated logistics、rural sensing 等 multi-operator collaboration use cases。
- challenge 包含 high bandwidth、radar equation、power density、spectrum coexistence 與 waveform design。

6G NTN 展望 › Multi-function satellite services（MFSS）
[[MFSS]] 是將 communications、navigation、earth observation、monitoring、sensing 等 satellite services 整合的概念。

- Phase 1：同一 satellite 整合多個獨立 hardware / services。
- Phase 2：可能整合 joint waveform，例如 communications + radar sensing，或 communications method 提供 timing information。

MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes › 重點摘要
- [[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓使用者可直接使用 [[MVG]] antenna measurement systems 執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] [[OTA testing]] signaling tests。
- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 被描述為支援 full stack generation and analysis of 4G、[[5G NR]]、[[WLAN]] 與 [[LTE]] signals。
- 與 [[MVG]] multi-probe measurement systems 搭配時，來源稱可在 real-world conditions 下進行 precise OTA testing。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合後，來源稱 [[MVG]] systems 可處理 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）mode、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）signaling testing。
- 來源稱整合支援 multiple hardware configurations of the [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]，包括 `CMX Lite` 與 `CMX Pro`；但未提供正式料號、BOM 或與既有 [[R&S CMX500]] standard hardware configurations 的對照。
- 來源列出可支援的標準 / 場景包括 [[5G NR FR1]] SA、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]。
- 來源稱此整合可移除 earlier setups 的複雜度，減少 preparation and measurements 所需時間，並加速 development cycles。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 以 [[MVG]] Chief Commercial Officer 身分表示，MVG 決定支援 different OBT configurations，並正快速擴充測試能力到 WiFi technologies，尤其是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，[[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 multi-band capabilities 可顯著簡化 OTA test setup。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- [[MVG]] 公司資訊：Microwave Vision Group 提供 electromagnetic waves visualization 技術、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 測試方案；營運於 10 個國家，90% sales from exports，revenues exceeding €100 million。

Option 表資料品質審查 › R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是最大問題區塊，[[review-options]] 指出 `71` 列需要判斷。

需要注意：

- `R&S®SMW-B10xx`、`R&S®SMW-B1xxx`、`R&S®SMW-B1xxxO`、`R&S®SMW-B20xx`、`R&S®SMW-B2xx`、`R&S®SMW-B2xxx` 是 placeholder candidate。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` 與 `R&S®SMW-B10` 在正式 [[R&S SMW200A]] 頁已作為 wideband / standard baseband generator 記錄；[[review-options]] 說「表裡沒有」是指抽取表沒有對應列。
- `R&S®SMW-B13` / `R&S®SMW-B13T` / `R&S®SMW-B13XT` 常出現在 baseband main module requires 中，且有 `or` 條件。
- `R&S®SMW-B13` 與 `R&S®SMW-B13T` 不可與 O frequency options 搭配，包括 `R&S®SMW-B1044O`、`R&S®SMW-B2044O`、`R&S®SMW-B1056O`、`R&S®SMW-B1067O`。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] waveform package、digital standards、GNSS channels、fading、MIMO、pulse sequencing 等 software options 有大量「可安裝兩次」或「兩個 baseband generators 同時使用需兩份 option」規則。

Option 表資料品質審查 › 核心問題
依 [[review-options]]，Option 表共有 `1535` 列，其中 `161` 列需要人工判斷，涵蓋 `26` 台儀器。這些問題不是產品規格本身的錯誤，而是從 datasheet / configuration guide 抽取成表格時產生的資料建模與資料品質問題。

主要類型：

1. **placeholder code 被抽成真實 code**  
   例如 `R&S®SMW-B10xx`、`R&S®ZNAXx-B161`、`R&S®SMAB-B1xx`、`R&S®SMM-B10xx`、`R&S®ZNAxx-B41`、`R&S®ZN-ZE1xx`。來源判斷這些多半是 datasheet 用 `xx` / `xxx` 表示任一系列型號或任一 frequency option 的佔位符，不應直接作為可報價 code。

2. **requires / excludes 欄位無法表達原文邏輯**  
   原文常見 `or`、`and`、model-dependent、path-dependent、quantity-dependent 條件，例如「`R&S®SMW-B13 or R&S®SMW-B13T`」、「`R&S®FSV3-K144 option or R&S®FSV3-K145 and R&S®FSV3-K148 options`」、「two or four installed options」。若表格只能填單一 code，會造成假缺漏或錯誤依賴。

3. **requires 指向表中不存在的 code**  
   [[review-options]] 多次指出 `SMW-B9/-B10`、`R&S®SMW-B13T`、`R&S®SMW-B13XT`、`R&S®FSWP-K60`、`R&S®FSWP-K70` 等被 requires 引用，但抽取表中沒有對應列。這通常代表 option table coverage gap，不代表正式 datasheet 沒有該 option。

4. **缺描述 code**  
   例如 `R&S®ZNA26-B16x`、`R&S®ZNA43-B16x`、`R&S®ZNA50-B16x`、`R&S®ZNA67-B16x`、`R&S®FSV3-B1000`、`R&S®FSV3-B600`、`R&S®NRP-Z8x`、`R&S®FS-SNS18` 等需要回查原文補描述。

5. **OCR / 表格抽取錯位**  
   [[R&S AREG800A]] frontends、system alignment options、[[R&S AREG8-K553]] 與 [[R&S QAT100]] 相鄰片段出現文字錯位風險；應回查原 PDF 或既有正式來源頁，不應用相鄰片段直接覆蓋產品頁。

CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32 › WLAN signaling 與 measurement
- WLAN signaling 支援 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn、AP testing、station testing、single user 2x2 MIMO、advanced encryption and authentication。
- 若相關 options 都可用，[[R&S CMX500]] 支援 simultaneous WLAN AP and station emulation。
- WLAN measurement options 支援 WLAN TX measurements：802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 True MIMO。
- WLAN measurement RF frequency 依 hardware 而定，涵蓋 2.4 GHz、4 GHz、5 GHz、6 GHz operating bands，也支援 out-of-band frequencies；802.11ax SISO input signal settings 明示 RF frequency 為 all WLAN frequency bands up to 7.125 GHz。
- WLAN measurement bandwidth 依 standard 支援 5 MHz、10 MHz、20 MHz、40 MHz、80 MHz、160 MHz、320 MHz。

CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32 › LTE measurements
- R&S CMX-KM500 提供 LTE uplink measurements，支援含 PUCCH/PUSCH signals、random access preambles、sounding reference signals。
- LTE uplink multi-evaluation 支援 FDD / TDD signals、channel bandwidth 1.4 MHz、3 MHz、5 MHz、10 MHz、15 MHz、20 MHz、normal 或 extended cyclic prefix、arbitrary resource block allocation，以及 QPSK、16QAM、64QAM。
- Carrier aggregation 支援 intraband contiguous UL CA signals；可量測 two、three 或 four carriers depending on bandwidth class。
- LTE sidelink measurements 由 R&S CMX-KM570 提供，RF operating band 為 band 47。

| Dynamic part | 由 non-permanently visible dynamic cells 組成；較適合 connected mode，UE initial access 後由 network handover 到 dynamic node。 |

此模型的動機是降低 UE 在 idle mode 長時間掃描 dynamic network nodes 的 power consumption。

6G NTN 展望 › 3GPP timeline to 6G NTN
來源說：

- 3GPP 於 2023 年 12 月承諾開發 6G specifications。
- Rel. 20 預期啟動 6G use cases / service requirements / technology studies。
- 6G system-level 與 RAN-level technical specifications 預期在 Rel. 21 開始。
- 6G normative phase 預期持續到 2028 年底。
- Timeline 與 [[WRC-27]]、[[WRC-31]]、IMT-2030、Olympic games 2028 / 2030 等外部節點對齊。

6G NTN 展望 › Waveforms 與 air interface
6G NTN waveform / air interface research 包含：

- OFDMA enhancements。
- [[OTFS]]：適合 high Doppler；把 signal 轉換到 delay-Doppler domain。
- [[FDSS]]：降低 PAPR，改善 uplink-constrained NTN power efficiency；來源稱可改善 link budget 約 4 dB 到 5 dB。
- ECRA / grant-free IoT access：結合 asynchronous retransmission 與 SIC receiver，用於大量 small packet IoT access。
- circular constellation mapping、APSK、semantic coding、joint-source-channel coding。
- NOMA、full duplex、flexible TDD、multi-radio shared spectrum。

6G NTN 展望 › 使用限制
- 本頁多數內容屬 outlook、research project、study item 或 proposal，不是 finalized 6G specification。
- 來源中的 6G topics 包含 [[TR 22.870]]、[[TR 38.914]]、IMT-2030、RSPG、6G-TakeOff、6G-Coverage、6G-NTN 等多來源脈絡；正式需求需回查各文件。
- 6G waveform、security、AI、RIS、MFSS、PNT、ISAC、semantic coding 與 routing architecture 皆不可推論為現有產品功能。

6G NTN 展望 › AI for NTN
來源將 AI in 6G 分為：

- AI on RAN。
- AI for RAN。
- AI and RAN。

對 NTN 最相關的是 AI for RAN，可支援：

- energy management。
- anti-jamming。
- traffic forecasting。
- beam hopping。
- predictive handover。
- traffic scheduling。
- topology-aware learning。
- channel coefficient prediction。
- dynamic routing tables。
- self-healing、load balancing、fraud detection。

但來源明確提醒：AI/ML 可在 feasible regions 內最佳化，不能克服物理限制；例如 speed of light、LEO topology dynamics、Doppler shift 仍存在。

| FMCW radar and near-object testing require artificial-object generation tied to air gap and short-distance behavior [8][58]. | The tester must generate radar echoes with minimum artificial-object distance from air gap or short ranges such as <17 m + air gap, <4 m + air gap, or ≥ air gap, depending on option [8][58]. | AREG800A digital echo generation is used for FMCW radar, with minimum generated distance equal to the radar under test’s air gap value and maximum generated distance 3000 m [8]; artificial-object distance options include <17 m + air gap, <4 m + air gap, and ≥ air gap [58]. |

Option 表資料品質審查 › 核心問題
依 [[review-options]]，Option 表共有 `1535` 列，其中 `161` 列需要人工判斷，涵蓋 `26` 台儀器。這些問題不是產品規格本身的錯誤，而是從 datasheet / configuration guide 抽取成表格時產生的資料建模與資料品質問題。

主要類型：

1. **placeholder code 被抽成真實 code**  
   例如 `R&S®SMW-B10xx`、`R&S®ZNAXx-B161`、`R&S®SMAB-B1xx`、`R&S®SMM-B10xx`、`R&S®ZNAxx-B41`、`R&S®ZN-ZE1xx`。來源判斷這些多半是 datasheet 用 `xx` / `xxx` 表示任一系列型號或任一 frequency option 的佔位符，不應直接作為可報價 code。

2. **requires / excludes 欄位無法表達原文邏輯**  
   原文常見 `or`、`and`、model-dependent、path-dependent、quantity-dependent 條件，例如「`R&S®SMW-B13 or R&S®SMW-B13T`」、「`R&S®FSV3-K144 option or R&S®FSV3-K145 and R&S®FSV3-K148 options`」、「two or four installed options」。若表格只能填單一 code，會造成假缺漏或錯誤依賴。

3. **requires 指向表中不存在的 code**  
   [[review-options]] 多次指出 `SMW-B9/-B10`、`R&S®SMW-B13T`、`R&S®SMW-B13XT`、`R&S®FSWP-K60`、`R&S®FSWP-K70` 等被 requires 引用，但抽取表中沒有對應列。這通常代表 option table coverage gap，不代表正式 datasheet 沒有該 option。

4. **缺描述 code**  
   例如 `R&S®ZNA26-B16x`、`R&S®ZNA43-B16x`、`R&S®ZNA50-B16x`、`R&S®ZNA67-B16x`、`R&S®FSV3-B1000`、`R&S®FSV3-B600`、`R&S®NRP-Z8x`、`R&S®FS-SNS18` 等需要回查原文補描述。

5. **OCR / 表格抽取錯位**  
   [[R&S AREG800A]] frontends、system alignment options、[[R&S AREG8-K553]] 與 [[R&S QAT100]] 相鄰片段出現文字錯位風險；應回查原 PDF 或既有正式來源頁，不應用相鄰片段直接覆蓋產品頁。

6G NTN 展望 › Two-stage network access model
來源引述 [[6G-TakeOff]] 提出 UE network access 的 two-stage model：

| Stage | 功能 |
|---|---|
| Anchor part | 提供 downlink synchronization signals、system information、uplink random access；適合 camping、first access、initial connectivity。 |
| Dynamic part | 由 non-permanently visible dynamic cells 組成；較適合 connected mode，UE initial access 後由 network handover 到 dynamic node。 |

此模型的動機是降低 UE 在 idle mode 長時間掃描 dynamic network nodes 的 power consumption。

answer.text:
The passages do not directly state how radar-technology changes affect requirements for a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester, but they support the following technical implication: newer radar-related needs move beyond ordinary communication signaling/protocol tests toward RF/non-signaling and radar-echo capabilities such as higher frequency coverage, wider bandwidth, dynamic artificial objects, distance/RCS/Doppler control, and multi-object or frontend configurations [4][8][57][58][59][60][61].
| Radar technology change / need | Measurement capability affected | Supported evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Higher radar RF bands, especially automotive radar at 76 GHz to 81 GHz, require tester capability beyond a CMX500-style communication RF range of 400 MHz to 8 GHz [49][61]. | Non-signaling / radar test capability needs mmWave radar frontend or echo-generation coverage rather than only sub-8 GHz communication signaling [49][61]. | CMX500 RF range is 400 MHz to 8 GHz for LTE, 5G and Wi‑Fi UE signaling test [49]; AREG800A radar frontends cover 76 GHz to 81 GHz and 24 GHz to 24.25 GHz, with FE44S at 24 GHz to 44 GHz [61]. |
| Wider radar instantaneous bandwidth increases required IF/baseband bandwidth capability [61]. | A radar-capable non-signaling tester or echo generator needs IF bandwidth options at 1 GHz, 2 GHz or 5 GHz, not only communication-channel RF measurements [61]. | AREG800A base unit instantaneous IF bandwidth is 1 GHz, 2 GHz or 5 GHz depending on option, with overrange of 1.2 GHz, 2.2 GHz or 5.2 GHz [61]. |
| FMCW radar and near-object testing require artificial-object generation tied to air gap and short-distance behavior [8][58]. | The tester must generate radar echoes with minimum artificial-object distance from air gap or short ranges such as <17 m + air gap, <4 m + air gap, or ≥ air gap, depending on option [8][58]. | AREG800A digital echo generation is used for FMCW radar, with minimum generated distance equal to the radar under test’s air gap value and maximum generated distance 3000 m [8]; artificial-object distance options include <17 m + air gap, <4 m + air gap, and ≥ air gap [58]. |
| Longer-range and dynamic object scenarios require dynamic artificial-object generation over large distance ranges [8][58]. | The tester needs dynamic echo generation with covered artificial-object distance up to 3000 m, or 350 m in specified production frontend configurations [8][58]. | AREG800A echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation [8]; covered artificial-object distance can be <17 m to 3000 m, <4 m to 3000 m, ≥ air gap to 3000 m, or in production frontend configurations FMCW ≥ air gap to 350 m and non-FMCW <17 m to 350 m [58]. |
| Radar target-strength variation requires RCS control and dynamic range [57]. | The tester needs dynamic RCS range and fine RCS step size capability [57]. | AREG800A dynamic RCS range is 90 dB for all artificial objects on one IF path with listed AREG8 frontends, >60 dB with QAT100, 60 dB for multiple objects per IF path with listed AREG8 frontends, and RCS control step size is 0.1 dB [57]. |
| Moving-target simulation requires Doppler and radial-velocity capability [59]. | The tester needs individual Doppler frequency shift, velocity range, velocity step size, Doppler accuracy and velocity accuracy capability [59]. | AREG800A supports individual Doppler frequency shift per artificial object, velocity setting range ±500 km/h with AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, velocity step size 0.001 km/h for AREG8-B9 and AREG8-B63, Doppler frequency offset accuracy <1 Hz, and velocity accuracy <0.05 km/h [59]. |
| Multi-channel or production radar configurations require multiple digital channels and frontend configurations [60]. | The tester configuration may need one, two, or three digital channels and monostatic or bistatic frontend support depending on radar production configuration [60]. | AREG-P1 / AREG-DBP1 provides one digital channel and one object per channel, AREG-P2 / AREG-DBP2 provides two digital channels, and AREG-P3 / AREG-DBP3 provides three digital channels with AREG-MFP / AREG-BFP frontend option supporting monostatic or bistatic operation [60]. |
| Communication signaling testers remain oriented to LTE, NR and WLAN signaling, protocol/application/RF communication measurements rather than radar echo generation [1][4]. | Signaling tester capability is still relevant for communication links and de-sense validation, but the cited CMX500 signaling functions do not state automotive radar echo generation capability [1][4]. | Signaling test can include basic RF measurements, application-layer tests and protocol test, with basic RF measurements including Power, Frequency, Spectrum, EVM, PER/BLER and MIMO [1]; CMX500 supports LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN signaling and TX measurements, BLER, throughput and PER measurement [4]. |
| For UAV or multi-radio products, multiple communication technologies can create mutual interference, so signaling testing may need multi-technology de-sense validation rather than radar measurement [1]. | The communication tester requirement is multi-technology support and combined configuration for de-sense validation, not radar echo simulation in the cited passage [1]. | The source says if a UAV uses two or more communication technologies, those technologies may interfere with each other, and because CMX500 supports multiple communication technologies, it can be used for de-sense validation [1]. |
| Non-signaling is only identified in the raw passages as RF, while signaling is identified as protocol / pre-conformance [99]. | The passages support only a high-level distinction that radar-like RF measurement demands would align more with non-signaling RF capability than with signaling protocol capability [99]. | RAW states “Non-signaling - RF” and “Signaling - Protocol Pre-conformance” [99]. |
【推論】As radar technology moves toward mmWave bands, wider bandwidth, FMCW near-object behavior, dynamic objects, RCS and Doppler, the required tester capability shifts from only communication signaling/protocol measurements toward non-signaling RF plus dedicated radar echo-generation capability such as AREG800A-class functions [49][61][8][57][58][59][99].
